collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART X (181-200, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: An elder who still feels thirty-five catches their reflection in the stream and does not recognize it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Inside, (name1) feels about thirty. Maybe thirty-five. (He/She) still thinks of (him/her)self as one of the young ones, really. Then, kneeling to drink at the stream, (he/she) catches (his/her) reflection in the still water, and for a moment doesn't recognize the old face looking back. Then (he/she) does.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) sits back on (his/her) heels. When did that happen? It doesn't feel like long ago that (he/she) was the young one being told off by the elders. Now (he/she) is the elder. (He/She) doesn't feel sad about it, exactly. Just surprised, the way you're surprised to find the tide has come in while you weren't looking. (He/She) drinks (his/her) water and goes home.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "Well, look at you," (name1) says to the reflection. The reflection looks back, wrinkled and white-haired and a bit startled. (name1) pulls a face at it. It pulls a face back. (He/She) laughs out loud, and the reflection breaks up into ripples. (He/She) still feels thirty-five. (He/She) just looks like (he/she) has had a very interesting time getting here.
